title: 2027 Lexus IS Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Lexus IS is largely unchanged after a refresh for 2026, but gains a new Special Appearance Package model that features some bespoke trim and color options.
body_markdown:
The Lexus IS sport sedan is long overdue a full overhaul, but it still looks and feels cool, lending some street cred to the crossover-heavy brand. Competitors include the BMW 3 Series, the Mercedes-Benz C-Class, the Genesis G70, and the Acura Integra.

## What’s New for the 2027 Lexus IS


The current Lexus IS was introduced for the 2021 model year, although it was in fact a heavily updated version of the car that went on sale for 2014. Lexus has continued to update the IS, though, and a range of cosmetic and tech upgrades were part of a refresh for 2026. Changes for 2027 are therefore minor, but they include a new Special Appearance Package that combines exclusive Envious Green paint with 19-inch forged alloy BBS wheels with a black finish, and black sport seats with green contrast stitching. In addition, F Sport Design models have a new 19-inch wheel design and a standard heated steering wheel.


## Design


The exterior design of the Lexus IS still looks classy, thanks in part to some updates for 2026. It includes LED front and rear lighting and 19-inch wheels. Options include upgraded wheel designs and the new Special Appearance Package.


## Powertrain


Though the IS lineup used to include a competitively wide variety of engines, it’s now powered exclusively by a 3.5-liter V6 engine with 311 horsepower and 280 pound-feet of torque. The IS comes standard with rear-wheel drive (RWD) and an eight-speed automatic transmission, and it’s available with all-wheel drive (AWD) and a six-speed automatic transmission. Stepping up from the F Sport Design to the F Sport brings a tuned suspension system to match the sharper looks. The F Sport is also offered with lightweight forged aluminum wheels and a Handling Package that adds an adaptive suspension system, a limited-slip differential, and selectable driving modes. Regardless of drive type, the Lexus IS earns EPA ratings of 22 mpg combined.


## Interior


The Lexus IS has the kind of snug interior that buyers might be inclined to call “cozy” if they're sport sedan aficionados. The optional high-bolstered front sport seats elevate the experience with plenty of comfort and support, but space in the second row is tight. Although the interior looks a little outdated in places, build quality is solid. Standard features include synthetic leather upholstery and heated front seats. Options include ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, a power-adjustable driver’s seat, limited-edition upholstery color palettes, and a sunroof. The IS has a small trunk with just 10.8 cubic feet of cargo space.


## Technology


The Lexus IS features a pair of 12.3-inch screens, a digital instrument cluster, and a touchscreen infotainment system. The system features wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity and a 10-speaker stereo. The system is user-friendly and intuitive, with plenty of physical controls nearby. There aren’t many options in terms of technology, though Lexus offers a 17-speaker Mark Levinson audio system.

## Safety


Lexus equips the IS with a long list of standard safety and driver-assistance equipment, with many of the features bundled under the Lexus Safety System+ (LSS+) 3.0 package. They include adaptive cruise control, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, cyclist detection, motorcyclist detection, intersection assist, lane-departure warning, lane-keep assist, lane-centering assist, evasive-steering assist, and the relatively new Proactive Driving Assist system, which kicks in with steering and braking assist when the vehicle deems it necessary. Other standard features include blind-spot monitors, safe-exit assist, and rear cross-traffic alert. Options include a surround-view camera system, front and rear cross-traffic alert, rear automatic braking, park assist with automatic braking, and traffic-jam assist, which allows hands-free driving in stop-and-go traffic. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration had not crash-tested the Lexus IS at the time of writing, while the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety gave it mixed ratings in the two crash tests it conducted.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Lexus IS is on sale now. At the time of writing, the IS 350 F Sport Design started at $47,545 (including destination) and the IS 350 F Sport Design AWD at $49,545. The IS 350 F Sport starts at $49,845 and the IS 350 F Sport AWD at $51,845. If these prices look confusing, keep in mind that the Design models feature a performance-inspired styling package, rather than the actual F Sport performance upgrades. There’s a big jump in price to the new-for-2027 models: the IS 350 F Sport Special Appearance Package retails at $60,185, or $61,795 with AWD.
